import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

DATASET_PATH = 'chunks_csv/cyclehire_w004.csv'
ADJACENCY_PATH = 'chunks_csv/borough_adjacency.csv'

# Load data

adj = pd.read_csv(ADJACENCY_PATH)

# Compute Self-Containment Index
departures = df['StartBorough'].value_counts()
arrivals = df['EndBorough'].value_counts()
self_contained = df[df['StartBorough'] == df['EndBorough']]['StartBorough'].value_counts()

all_boroughs = sorted(set(departures.index).union(set(arrivals.index)))
departures = departures.reindex(all_boroughs, fill_value=0)
arrivals = arrivals.reindex(all_boroughs, fill_value=0)
self_contained = self_contained.reindex(all_boroughs, fill_value=0)

total_arrivals = arrivals.sum()
arrival_share = arrivals / total_arrivals
expected_self = departures * arrival_share
index_vals = self_contained / expected_self
index_vals = index_vals.sort_index()

# Filter adjacency to data boroughs
data_boroughs = set(all_boroughs)
adj_filtered = adj[(adj['borough'].isin(data_boroughs)) & (adj['neighbor'].isin(data_boroughs))].copy()
adj_sym = pd.concat([adj_filtered, adj_filtered.rename(columns={'borough':'neighbor','neighbor':'borough'})], ignore_index=True)
adj_sym = adj_sym.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)

neighbors = {b: set() for b in all_boroughs}
for _, row in adj_sym.iterrows():
    neighbors[row['borough']].add(row['neighbor'])
for b in neighbors:
    neighbors[b].discard(b)

print('Neighbor list:')
for b in sorted(all_boroughs):
    print(b, '->', sorted(neighbors[b]))

# Build row-standardized W
borough_list = sorted(all_boroughs)
n = len(borough_list)
idx_map = {b: i for i, b in enumerate(borough_list)}
W = np.zeros((n, n))

    i = idx_map[b]
    deg = len(neighbors[b])
    if deg > 0:
        for nb in neighbors[b]:
            j = idx_map[nb]
            W[i, j] = 1.0 / deg

x = np.array([index_vals[b] for b in borough_list])
z = x - x.mean()

def morans_i(z, W):
    n = len(z)
    cross = np.dot(np.dot(z, W), z)
    denom = np.dot(z, z)
    S0 = W.sum()
    return (n / S0) * (cross / denom)

observed_I = morans_i(z, W)
print('Observed I:', observed_I)

# Run 5000 permutations with multiple seeds to check stability
for seed in [42, 123, 999]:

    n_perm = 5000

    print(f'Seed {seed}: p = {p_val:.5f}, mean perm I = {perm_I.mean():.5f}')
